shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -i -E "dropdown|menu|button|popup"

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/
(ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "---"; git status --short
